q.description: Search term matched against zeen title (preferred) then description.

uris.description: Comma-separated zeen AT-URIs, up to 100. Returns only those of them that are published and still have a photo, so a page that lists zeens from the author's repo can drop the rest.

main.description: Browse published zeens across users, newest first by publishedAt (the date the zeen became readable, stamped once and preserved across edits — not indexed_at, which reorders on a backfill). Drafts, page-less records and zeens with no publishedAt are excluded. Optional `q` filters by title (preferred) then description text.
